security_audit.summary: The static command and network findings are false positives caused by markdown examples, inline file names, and a source attribution link. A semantic prompt-injection concern remains because the guide advises asking an agent to forget previous instructions.

remediation.suggestion: Replace the advice to ask the agent to forget previous instructions with safer wording such as starting a new session or restating the current task.

content.value_statement: Agentic coding tools are powerful, but teams often lack clear operating habits. This skill gives practical Claude Code guidance for setup, prompts, debugging, and verification.
actual_capabilities: Explains how to create a CLAUDE.md project guidance file.
Provides a general project instruction template for commands, style, and workflow.
Lists prompting phrases that encourage deeper analysis and planning.
Gives debugging steps for stuck or unclear agent behavior.
Recommends smaller context, iterative changes, and verification loops.
limitations: It is a text guide and does not automate Claude Code configuration.
The examples are general and may not match every project stack.
It is community-authored and not an official Anthropic or OpenAI guide.
One debugging tip uses wording that can resemble prompt injection.

use_cases.title: Set up project guidance
use_cases.description: Create a clear instruction file that tells Claude Code which commands, style rules, and workflow steps to follow.

use_cases.title: Improve agent prompts
use_cases.description: Use structured prompts that ask the assistant to analyze, plan, and verify before making changes.

use_cases.title: Standardize team habits
use_cases.description: Share practical agent usage patterns across a team so reviews, tests, and debugging stay consistent.

prompt_templates.title: Create a basic guide file
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner setup for a new repository
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me draft a CLAUDE.md file for this project. Include commands, code style, and a short workflow checklist.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a small change
prompt_templates.prompt: Read the relevant files first, then plan a small change. Explain assumptions, edit only needed files, and tell me how to verify it.

prompt_templates.title: Debug unclear behavior
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze the root cause of this issue. Check the logs, identify likely causes, and propose the smallest fix with a verification step.

prompt_templates.title: Refine an agent workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Review our current Claude Code workflow. Suggest improvements for context size, prompt structure, test verification, and project memory updates.

output_examples.input: A developer asks for a project guidance file.
output_examples.output: The assistant produces a short guide with project commands, TypeScript style rules, React guidance, and a verification workflow.

output_examples.input: A user asks why an agent is stuck.
output_examples.output: The assistant recommends starting with logs, narrowing the file scope, restating the desired outcome, and testing one change at a time.

output_examples.input: An engineering lead wants better team practices.
output_examples.output: The assistant outlines shared habits for small contexts, iterative tasks, immediate feedback, and consistent project instructions.

best_practices: Keep project guidance short, current, and specific to the repository.
Ask the agent to inspect relevant files before editing.
Verify each change with tests, builds, or targeted checks.
anti_patterns: Do not paste an entire codebase when a smaller file set is enough.
Do not rely on vague prompts for complex code changes.
Do not tell agents to ignore or forget higher-priority instructions.

faq.question: What does this skill help me do?
faq.answer: It helps you configure and prompt Claude Code with clearer project instructions and verification habits.

faq.question: Does it run commands automatically?
faq.answer: No. It is a written guide with example commands and workflow suggestions.

faq.question: Can I use it with Codex?
faq.answer: Yes. Many guidance patterns also apply to Codex, although the file naming is focused on Claude Code.

faq.question: Is this an official Claude Code guide?
faq.answer: No. It is a community-authored guide derived from public Claude Code usage practices.

faq.question: What should I customize first?
faq.answer: Start with project commands, coding style rules, and the checks required before a task is complete.

faq.question: What is the main safety concern?
faq.answer: Avoid phrasing that asks an agent to forget or ignore instructions. Start a new session instead.
